title: codiaeum pictum
intro: Codiaeum pictum, commonly known as Croton, is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is known for its vibrant foliage, which is a rich source of antioxidants and has been used for various health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Codiaeum pictum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Codiaeum pictum also include wound healing, pain relief, and antiviral activity, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
